policy.purpose: Survey Kaggle lyric datasets for private/personal-use scratch-model data expansion.
policy.reason: Kaggle dataset licenses often describe the uploader's dataset package, but lyric text can still have an unclear underlying copyright and redistribution chain.

ranking_notes: Prioritize high row count, direct lyric text, English or language metadata, and simple tabular formats.
Treat scraped Genius, Spotify, AZLyrics, and generic lyric-site sources as private-only unless item-level rights are later proven.
Preserve Kaggle slug, Kaggle license label, source claims, file manifests, hashes, row counts, language fields, and any explicit scraper/source notes.

candidates.name: English Music Lyrics 5 Genres (500k)
candidates.observed_source_notes: Kaggle listing describes lyrics text with genre labels.
risk_flags: underlying lyric copyrights not proven by Kaggle license label
candidates.next_action: Download first after Kaggle credentials are configured; inspect schema, language, duplicates, and source notes.

candidates.name: 5 Million Song Lyrics Dataset
candidates.observed_size_or_count: 5 million lyric records; listing indicates about 3 GB
risk_flags: large enough to require staged validation before full ingest
candidates.next_action: Download as a private-only bulk source if disk/time budget allows; sample first and dedupe against existing song_lyrics.csv.

candidates.name: Genius Song Lyrics with Language Information
candidates.observed_size_or_count: Derived from 5 Million Song Lyrics Dataset with language labels
candidates.observed_source_notes: Builds on the 5M lyrics dataset and adds language detection.
risk_flags: language labels are useful but inherited rights risk remains
candidates.next_action: Use if language filtering is worth more than maximum raw volume.

candidates.name: Song Lyrics Dataset
candidates.observed_size_or_count: Kaggle listing says lyrics of various artists
candidates.observed_source_notes: Source provenance not established from search/listing snippets.
risk_flags: CC0 label may not establish rights to underlying copyrighted lyrics
candidates.next_action: Download and inspect as a small/medium private source; do not promote to clean core from CC0 label alone.

candidates.name: Spotify Lyrics Dataset
candidates.observed_size_or_count: Listing mentions 10k and planned 100k lyric records
candidates.observed_source_notes: Listing says lyrics were crawled from Spotify tracks and lyric web pages.
risk_flags: CC0 package label does not resolve lyric rights
candidates.next_action: Lower priority than 500k/5M sources; useful for metadata shape experiments.

candidates.name: Chords and Lyrics Dataset
risk_flags: chord/lyric site provenance likely needs inspection
format may require chord stripping before lyric training
candidates.next_action: Use after bulk lyric datasets if chord-aware structure becomes useful.

candidates.name: Audio features and lyrics of Spotify songs
candidates.observed_source_notes: Listing says lyrics were added using a Genius library and language detection.
risk_flags: smaller/metadata-oriented relative to bulk lyric sources
candidates.next_action: Use for metadata-feature experiments, not primary token volume.

candidates.name: 150K Lyrics Labeled with Spotify Valence
risk_flags: share-alike package license does not prove lyric redistribution rights
labels may be useful for conditioning but not bulk scale
candidates.next_action: Consider later for control tags or preference/eval metadata.
